name: Separable Hessian and Gradient Computation
definition: A method to compute the Hessian matrix and gradient vector of a volume by decomposing the 3D Gaussian derivative convolution into three sequential 1D convolutions, reducing computational complexity.
summary: Separable Hessian and Gradient Computation computes volume derivatives by decomposing 3D Gaussian convolution into efficient 1D passes, reducing complexity from cubic to linear per voxel.
